summary: Identity flow with emotional needs. This fluid pattern asks you to use confidence and emotional intelligence with awareness.
body: Identity flow with emotional needs. This fluid pattern asks you to use confidence and emotional intelligence with awareness. Outer and inner self move easily together. Steady, consistent, at ease with oneself, though it can lack a charge of its own. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through identity, emotional needs, and the choices you make when ego defense or mood-driven reaction starts running the room.
gift: The gift is confidence, emotional intelligence, and a more conscious way to work with identity and emotional needs.
shadow: The shadow is ego defense, mood-driven reaction, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let identity and emotional needs cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.
do: Name how identity and emotional needs are both involved
Turn confidence and emotional intelligence into one concrete choice
dont: Let ego defense make the decision
Ignore the needs of identity or emotional needs
